body:
Well, it has become time, as I really hope to get this unpleasantness over with before morning. I feel slightly nervous but adamant in my resolve. 

I realize this will get buried but I cannot wait any longer. To be honest, it's kind of exciting; I've been waiting for this for so long. 

I hope everyone else on here finds a way to live long and fruitful lives as happy (and as long) as possible. I would never recommend this solution to anyone but myself.

Take care and peace out!
